verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Weaviate ships agentic features such as the Query Agent, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can consume external MCP servers' tools. The evidence only documents Weaviate acting as an MCP server that LLMs and IDE assistants connect to. That is the server role, a different story, and gets no credit here. No evidence shows Weaviate or its agents connecting to external MCP servers as a client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
